preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
For each test case, the length of the array N must be between 3 and 1000.
The sum of N over all test cases must not exceed 5000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly N space-separated integers for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**18 for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output must be between 1 and 10^18.

postconditions.expression: all(any(gcd(int(x), int(y)) == i for x in stdout.split() for y in stdout.split() if x != y) for i in range(1, N+1))
postconditions.description: For each i from 1 to N, there must exist a subsequence of length greater than 1 with gcd equal to i.
